Overview

Muncie is a city in IN with a population of 68,000. Middletown USA with Ball State University, the David Owsley Museum, and affordable living. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5a growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. The population skews young, with a median age of 29.5.
